client._source: setup guide names the world's own "Glover Client", which SCHEMA rule 1 says answers nothing. Rule 2 fails: no RAM map Plugins/Scripts/games/glover.lua exists. The guide's use of BizHawk is about the EMULATOR, and the schema names "what another game on the same console does" as explicitly not a source, so the protocol stays unestablished.
